wayback._eras_note: Three listing generations, inspected 2026-10-06 once the archive answered: thefoundersfund.com/portfolio.html (2005 placeholder with no companies, listings 2006-2009, logo blocks keyed on the company's own domain), foundersfund.com/portfolio.php (2009-2011, a plain name list linking <slug>.php profile pages), and WordPress /company/<slug> pages from 2011 on (218 distinct slugs in the index; the /portfolio page of 2014-2021 shows only a featured subset and is not an era). The first pull of 2026-10-01 started the /company/ era at 2014 and so dropped every slug first captured 2009-2013.

site_api._note: WordPress REST types company and team are public. HTTP pagination headers checked at kickoff: 64 companies, 30 people, one page each. No company field states the firm's entry round or investment year; CMS publication dates are not investment dates. Team titles are the site's subtitle field. Recheck pagination before future pulls.

roster._note: The initial roster is curated from current investing titles plus former partners and dated sources. Operational staff are not sweep targets. Captures extend the roster when accessible; the archive outage must not erase the curated roster.

edgar._note: Resolve each entity against CRD 155462's fund roster and addresses. The words 'founders fund' also occur inside unrelated fund names, including Benchmark, Spark, Oquirrh, Bowman and third-party feeders.

desks._note: Founders Fund LLC, CRD 155462, SEC 802-75555, is the ERA. Its 2026-03-30 ADV lists flagship and Growth management entities under common control. Principal office 1 Letterman Dr, Bldg D, 5th Floor, San Francisco; other office Miami. Name patterns are provisional until the entity registry is inspected.
